sections.text: Dollar index 103.66 (+1.7% in a month, +5.5% YTD). A stronger dollar makes US grain, oilseeds, cotton and meat dearer abroad. USD/BRL 5.815 (+17.2% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.675 (-0.0%); USD/MXN 19.61 (+4.7%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

us_econ: Jobs: payrolls +165k in 2026-10 (3-month average +137k), unemployment 4.1% (-0.1), wages 3.1% y/y. Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.63% (+0.75 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.12%, real 10-year 2.79%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +2.6% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,882 Bcf (week to 2026-11-13), +20 Bcf vs a 5-year average -25 for the week; +98 Bcf (+2.6%) vs the 5-year average, -54 vs last year. Crude stocks 417.8 mb (+3.4 mb on the week, -3.7% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline +5.2 mb, distillate +1.6 mb; refinery utilization 95.7%. 3-2-1 crack $36.73/bbl (ULSD $71.71, gasoline $19.24). NG weather/positioning: squeeze risk HIGH (2 of 7 cold-risk checks on; managed money net -211,476 (2nd pct of 3 yrs, -54,628 in 4 wks)). 15-day ensembles colder over 2-3 days: +8.7 HDD on matched dates (≈-14 Bcf); GEFS PNA week 2 +0.61 (western ridge / eastern trough). Squeeze risk high: forecasts are turning colder into a crowded fund short. Do not sell rallies or add outright shorts; short ideas wait until the forecast trend stalls. Options: NG IV 83% vs RV 66%; CL IV 47% vs RV 52%; HO IV 50% vs RV 49%; RB IV 44% vs RV 43%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
